nodes.summary: The permutation of $\{0, 1, \dots, 22\}$ that sends $i$ to $i + 1$ for $i < 22$ and sends $22$ to $0$, that is, the 23-cycle $(0\ 1\ 2\ \cdots\ 22)$. It is the first of the two standard generators of the Mathieu group $M_{23}$.
nodes.title: The standard 23-cycle in $M_{23}$

nodes.summary: The permutation of the points $\{0, 1, \dots, 22\}$ given by the product of the four disjoint 5-cycles $(2\ 16\ 9\ 6\ 8)(3\ 12\ 13\ 18\ 4)(7\ 17\ 10\ 11\ 22)(14\ 19\ 21\ 20\ 15)$, where a cycle $(a_1\ a_2\ \cdots\ a_5)$ sends $a_k$ to $a_{k+1}$ for $k < 5$ and sends $a_5$ to $a_1$. It fixes the three remaining points $0$, $1$ and $5$, and it is the second of the two standard generators of the Mathieu group $M_{23}$.
nodes.title: The standard product of four 5-cycles in $M_{23}$

nodes.summary: A subgroup $H$ of the symmetric group on $\{0, 1, \dots, 22\}$ contains the Mathieu group $M_{23}$ if and only if $H$ contains both the standard 23-cycle and the standard product of four 5-cycles that generate $M_{23}$.
nodes.title: Subgroups containing $M_{23}$

nodes.summary: The subgroup of the symmetric group on $\{0, 1, \dots, 22\}$ generated by the standard 23-cycle $(0\ 1\ 2\ \cdots\ 22)$ and the standard product of four disjoint 5-cycles $(2\ 16\ 9\ 6\ 8)(3\ 12\ 13\ 18\ 4)(7\ 17\ 10\ 11\ 22)(14\ 19\ 21\ 20\ 15)$.
nodes.title: The Mathieu group $M_{23}$

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
